sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday 24 October, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach sit top of the table with 31 points from 13 games and have won four of their last five league matches, with only a draw breaking that streak. Bridgnorth are fifth in the table with 24 points and recent form showing W-D-L-W-W-W, making them a competitive opponent despite their lower league position.
divisionWide: The title race features several in-form sides: Bilston Town (second, 26 points) host Widnes Town at Foley Meir, with both teams offering contrasting form—Bilston on five consecutive league wins versus Widnes enduring a lengthy winless stretch. Stafford Town, third on 25 points with recent form D-D-W-W-L, face Shawbury United, who are struggling with just one win in their last six league games. In the lower reaches, Brereton Social (13 points) meet fellow mid-table strugglers Dawley Town (15 points) in a fixture between sides with inconsistent recent results. Cheadle Heath Nomads (14 points) face Market Drayton Town (14 points) in a tight clash at the bottom end of the division.
